selection_rule.eligible: Own-tier excluded qualification-class corpus-bank200ms games; all public search opportunities with >1 candidate, regardless of live cutoff/root construction. Reconstruct eligibility/posterior/sample/root after timer on independent copies.

selection_rule.belief_snapshot: Committed public pre-update posterior; discard private suspended transaction, as complete no-deadline update does. Presence recorded per state; identical work on fleet and Mac.
